# Impulse Anvil — AI-readable product facts

Version documented: 1.0.121
Public format: Windows 64-bit VST3

Impulse Anvil is a creative convolution and impulse-response design tool. It can load IRs or compatible recordings into A/B, reshape them, combine them, and Bake the current prepared result as a 32-bit floating-point WAV.

## Current user-facing facts

- A/B/Morph audition is selected by clicking the corresponding panel.
- A and B have independent Normalize controls; Gain remains usable after Normalize.
- Shift-drag is fine movement; Ctrl-drag is very fine movement.
- Six Morph modes: Time Morph, Spectral, Spectral BandSwap, Spectral ZigZag, Stereo Slot Swap, Mid/Side Boundary.
- A-to-B Lerp uses Lerp Start and Lerp Time in absolute milliseconds.
- Lerp Time may be 0 ms for an instantaneous switch at Lerp Start.
- Draw lets users paint an A/B transition curve.
- Draw tools: U Undo, S Smooth, N precision Nodes, F Free endpoints, R Reset.
- Free Draw allows the first and last A/B blend to be anywhere from A to B.
- Path uses horizontal position as source-time and vertical position as A/B blend. Point order is playback order.
- Moving left in Path reads earlier source-time again, enabling reverse/replayed sections.
- Horizontal Path backtracking adds output duration.
- The Draw/Path graph shows A and B waveforms as visual landmarks for placing transitions and time routes.
- Color Offset range is 0–500 ms.
- Fade In/Out at 0 ms leaves the authored endpoint unshaped.
- Theme Schema 2 allows optional per-panel colors for A, B, Morph, EQ, EDIT and OUT.
- Manual IR Load remembers the last successfully browsed folder; bundled Factory IRs are a fresh-install fallback.
- Bake includes current Morph/Lerp/Draw/Path and the prepared IR shaping chain.
- Input, Wet Level, Dry/Wet and final Out are playback-only and are not embedded into Bake.
- Bake exports 32-bit float WAV.
- Successful Bake/theme export offers Show File.

- Theme Schema 2 can be exported, edited externally, and imported again. This enables AI-assisted theme generation from a reference image while preserving the required Impulse Anvil JSON structure.
